flows:
Navigate to https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/whiteNoiseGenerator.php then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Reach the navigation icon at the top of the White Noise Generator.
Press Enter and verify that Full Index is visible.

After the required Tab presses, the agent did not verify where keyboard focus was before pressing Enter. The screenshots show focus on the “myNoise BV” footer link, and Enter then attempted to open that link instead of the menu.
Update the run to inspect the focused element after every Tab or Shift+Tab movement and only press Enter once focus is visibly on the top-left navigation icon. Do not infer focus from the icon merely being visible.

verdict.root_cause: After the required Tab presses, the agent did not verify where keyboard focus was before pressing Enter. The screenshots show focus on the “myNoise BV” footer link, and Enter then attempted to open that link instead of the menu.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome by assuming it had reached the top navigation icon after moving focus with Shift+Tab. It pressed Enter without confirming focus on the visible navigation control. The resulting failed request was for the unintended footer destination, so this does not show that the White Noise Generator menu is broken.
